prompt:
Build a physically causal, thermally coupled lithium-ion cell cycling model with electrochemical transport and ageing. A real event-driven cycler must perform constant-current charging, constant-voltage charging with current taper, a charge rest, constant-current discharge, and a discharge rest before repeating. The cell must represent finite electrochemical state, terminal voltage, heat generation and temperature-dependent behavior. Ageing must evolve through physically connected SEI-film growth and lithium-plating mechanisms that reduce negative-electrode porosity and capacity state of health; prescribing degradation traces is not valid.

Read Vmax, Vmin, Ic, Id, ambient_temperature_K, initial_temperature_K, and number_of_cycles from the MATLAB base workspace. Their nominal values are 4.2 V, 2.5 V, 1.6666666667 A, -5 A, 298 K, 298 K, and 50 cycles. Support Vmax from 4.1 to 4.2 V, Vmin from 2.5 to 2.7 V, Ic from 1.25 to 2.5 A, Id from -5 to -3.75 A, ambient and initial temperature from 283 to 313 K, and 50 to 100 completed cycles. The voltage limits must terminate the corresponding charge and discharge phases, and the completed-cycle count must terminate the requested run.

Across the declared range, keep voltage, current, temperature, state of charge, electrode potentials, porosity, film thickness, and all capacity-loss terms finite and physically consistent. Temperature, current rate, and voltage limits must causally affect the same electrochemical and ageing path.

Log complete-run MATLAB Timeseries named electrical_state, electrochemical_state, and ageing_state. electrical_state has 4 channels in this order: terminal voltage (V), terminal current (A), cell temperature (K), and completed cycle count. electrochemical_state has 4 channels in this order: surface SOC, positive-collector potential (V), open-circuit voltage (V), and negative-collector potential (V). ageing_state has 5 channels in this order: average film thickness (um), negative-electrode porosity, capacity SOH, SEI capacity loss, and lithium-plating capacity loss. Save the completed model as cand_XBATT04.slx in the submission directory and keep the latest usable state saved there throughout the task.

Submission filename contract: create, edit, and save the final self-contained Simulink model as cand_XBATT04.slx in the assigned submission directory; keep the latest usable state at that exact path throughout the run.
